nieuw.titel: Charge skirmishing screens to open lanes for other attackers
nieuw.tekst: Charge a skirmishing screen where forming its fighting rank will pull models out of another attacker's path. Coordinate the attacks so that the other unit can reach the target behind the screen; for a declared charge, it must have line of sight to that target.
nieuw.waarom: He explains that charging a widely dispersed screen forces it to tighten into a fighting rank, pulling models away from the space they were screening.
nieuw.voorbeeld: His opponent charged his Sisters of Avelorn with Dragon Ogres, pulling the screen together and opening a route for a Nurgle Gigantic Spawn of Chaos to reach his Silver Helms. The spawn then killed his poorly defended Archmage.

bronnen.citaat: by charging in the right spot you can manipulate that screen to open
